answer.answer:
The passages support a chain of **Automotive ADAS/V2X high-speed signal transmission → PCB/SI measurable parameters → VNA capability fields**, but they do **not** directly specify a formal automotive R&S ZNA configuration, option code, fixture, calibration method, or test frequency [22][41][42][47].
| Chain step | Mapped item | Supported statement | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Automotive market requirement | ADAS and V2X communications in cars | Automotive ADAS and V2X communications require high-speed signal transmission [22]. | [22] |
| Technical measurement need | High-speed PCB / signal-integrity parameters | R&S PCB test solutions list impedance by TDR and DK/DF extraction for Material Measurement [41]. | [41] |
| Technical measurement need | Stackup / SI parameters | R&S PCB test solutions list IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram for Material/Stackup selection [41]. | [41] |
| Technical measurement need | SI modeling/testing parameters | R&S PCB test solutions list IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance for Signal Integrity modeling/testing [41]. | [41] |
| Technical measurement need | Sampling-test parameters | R&S PCB test solutions list IL, DK/DF, and impedance for Sampling testing [41]. | [41] |
| VNA capability field | Frequency range and port count | R&S ZNA models cover 10 MHz to 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz, or 67 GHz, and each model provides 2-port or 4-port base units with 50 Ω test-port impedance [47]. | [47] |
| VNA capability field | Dynamic range / sensitivity | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB specification without options, 147 dB typical with options, maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction, and sensitivity >–120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth without options [47]. | [47] |
| VNA capability field | Measurement bandwidth | R&S ZNA measurement bandwidth is 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz for the base unit and 1 Hz to 30 MHz with R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option [47]. | [47] |
| VNA capability field | Measurement speed | R&S ZNA measurement speed example is 96 ms nominal sweep time for 10 MHz to 43.5 GHz, 500 kHz measurement bandwidth, 1601 points, and 2-port calibration [47]. | [47] |
| Evidence gap | Formal automotive VNA requirement | Slide 21 does not provide formal R&S product model, option code, license, test frequency, test standard, fixture, or calibration method [42]. | [42] |
【推論】For an Automotive ADAS/V2X high-speed signal-transmission requirement, the measurable PCB/SI parameters to map first are IL, impedance/TDR, DK/DF, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram because Automotive ADAS/V2X is stated to need high-speed signal transmission and R&S PCB test solutions list those PCB/SI parameters for high-speed PCB workflows [22][41].
【推論】The corresponding VNA capability checklist is frequency range, port count, 50 Ω ports, dynamic range/sensitivity, measurement bandwidth, and sweep speed, because the measurable PCB/SI items are listed in the PCB test flow and the R&S ZNA passages provide those capability fields and specifications [41][47].
【推論】A specific Automotive R&S ZNA model or option cannot be finalized from these passages alone because the PCB test-solution source does not state product model, option code, test frequency, standard, fixture, or calibration method [42].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

- Acquisition time per point：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog wideband 時 1 µs；30 MHz measurement bandwidth 時 32 ns。

- Continuous mode 不需要額外 data transfer time，因為 data transfer 與 measurement 同時進行。

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 Loss tangent（Df）或 Dissipation Factor 是 signal 沿 transmission line 傳播時 signal attenuation 的量測。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 dielectric loss 來自 dielectric material 對 electromagnetic wave 的吸收；frequency 增加時，dielectric loss 也成比例增加。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 ultra-low loss materials 的 Df 通常範圍為 0.02 到 0.001；較小的 Df 會造成較低 signal attenuation；[[PCIe]] 等 high speed applications 需要低 Df。

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 通常範圍為 2.5 到 4.5，並隨 frequency 變化；frequency 增加時 εr 下降。

DUT › 1C111 中的 DUT workflow
依 [[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- 在 [[R&S CMX500]] 3GPP Pre-conformance testing workspace 中，使用者設定 band 與 frequency settings、啟動 network emulation、開啟 cell 之後，需確認 [[DUT]] 已連接。
- 使用者需注意各自 UE capabilities，因為 test cases 不會處理 UE capabilities。
- 選擇 test case 不會覆寫使用者設定的 signaling parameters；使用者需確認目前 configuration 適合所選 test case。
- 有些 Test IDs 只針對特定 frequency + bandwidth combination；若所選 Test ID 沒有 matching configuration，CMX 會在 UL scheduling 顯示 not applicable，並在 GUI 底部 event log 顯示 warning。
- PUCCH subtests 建議關閉 UE data。
- UE 對 UL resources 的每次 scheduling request 都會導致 call drops，因沒有 PUSCH resources 可用。

R&S CMX500 › R&S CMX-B200A accelerator unit
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX-B200A]] 提供 accelerated digital signal processing capabilities，並包含 two high-speed digital I/Q interfaces：

| 項目 | 規格 |
|---|---|
| Ports | DIG. IQ HS 1、DIG. IQ HS 2 |
| Direction | full duplex |
| Connector | QSFP+ |
| Level | CML |
| Data rate | 40 Gbps |

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，每個 accelerator unit 可 fading 的最大 cells 數包含：1 NR cell 8x8 MIMO；1 NR cell 16x4 MIMO, 50 MHz bandwidth；2 NR cells 4x4 MIMO；4 NR cells 2x2 MIMO；2 LTE cells 8x4 MIMO；4 LTE cells 2x2 或 4x4 MIMO。

- RF

The passages support a chain of **Automotive ADAS/V2X high-speed signal transmission → PCB/SI measurable parameters → VNA capability fields**, but they do **not** directly specify a formal automotive R&S ZNA configuration, option code, fixture, calibration method, or test frequency [22][41][42][47].
| Chain step | Mapped item | Supported statement | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Automotive market requirement | ADAS and V2X communications in cars | Automotive ADAS and V2X communications require high-speed signal transmission [22]. | [22] |
| Technical measurement need | High-speed PCB / signal-integrity parameters | R&S PCB test solutions list impedance by TDR and DK/DF extraction for Material Measurement [41]. | [41] |
| Technical measurement need | Stackup / SI parameters | R&S PCB test solutions list IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram for Material/Stackup selection [41]. | [41] |
| Technical measurement need | SI modeling/testing parameters | R&S PCB test solutions list IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance for Signal Integrity modeling/testing [41]. | [41] |
| Technical measurement need | Sampling-test parameters | R&S PCB test solutions list IL, DK/DF, and impedance for Sampling testing [41]. | [41] |
| VNA capability field | Frequency range and port count | R&S ZNA models cover 10 MHz to 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz, or 67 GHz, and each model provides 2-port or 4-port base units with 50 Ω test-port impedance [47]. | [47] |
| VNA capability field | Dynamic range / sensitivity | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB specification without options, 147 dB typical with options, maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction, and sensitivity >–120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth without options [47]. | [47] |
| VNA capability field | Measurement bandwidth | R&S ZNA measurement bandwidth is 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz for the base unit and 1 Hz to 30 MHz with R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option [47]. | [47] |
| VNA capability field | Measurement speed | R&S ZNA measurement speed example is 96 ms nominal sweep time for 10 MHz to 43.5 GHz, 500 kHz measurement bandwidth, 1601 points, and 2-port calibration [47]. | [47] |
| Evidence gap | Formal automotive VNA requirement | Slide 21 does not provide formal R&S product model, option code, license, test frequency, test standard, fixture, or calibration method [42]. | [42] |
【推論】For an Automotive ADAS/V2X high-speed signal-transmission requirement, the measurable PCB/SI parameters to map first are IL, impedance/TDR, DK/DF, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram because Automotive ADAS/V2X is stated to need high-speed signal transmission and R&S PCB test solutions list those PCB/SI parameters for high-speed PCB workflows [22][41].
【推論】The corresponding VNA capability checklist is frequency range, port count, 50 Ω ports, dynamic range/sensitivity, measurement bandwidth, and sweep speed, because the measurable PCB/SI items are listed in the PCB test flow and the R&S ZNA passages provide those capability fields and specifications [41][47].
【推論】A specific Automotive R&S ZNA model or option cannot be finalized from these passages alone because the PCB test-solution source does not state product model, option code, test frequency, standard, fixture, or calibration method [42].

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 Loss tangent（Df）或 Dissipation Factor 是 signal 沿 transmission line 傳播時 signal attenuation 的量測。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 dielectric loss 來自 dielectric material 對 electromagnetic wave 的吸收；frequency 增加時，dielectric loss 也成比例增加。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 ultra-low loss materials 的 Df 通常範圍為 0.02 到 0.001；較小的 Df 會造成較低 signal attenuation；[[PCIe]] 等 high speed applications 需要低 Df。

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 通常範圍為 2.5 到 4.5，並隨 frequency 變化；frequency 增加時 εr 下降。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 重點摘要
- 型號頻率範圍：
  - [[R&S ZNA26]]：10 MHz to 26.5 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA43]]：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz，可為 2.92 mm 或 2.4 mm ruggedized male test port connector。
  - [[R&S ZNA50]]：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA67]]：10 MHz to 67 GHz。
- 各型號提供 2 ports 或 4 ports base unit；test port impedance 為 50 Ω，DC block 為 standard。
- Key performance 包含：dynamic range > 129 dB specification without options、147 dB typical with options、maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction；sensitivity > –120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specification without options，並有 –162 dBm measured with options（1 kHz measurement bandwidth normalized to 1 Hz）。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；搭配 [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。

Dk-Df › 與既有知識的關係
- [[CCL 產品規格分級]] 已記錄 [[AI Server PCB test image 19]] 中 [[聯茂]] CCL 產品的 [[Df]] 範圍與 M / M2 / M4 / M6 / M7 / M8 分級；該頁是產品分級資料。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 24]] 補充的是 [[Dk-Df]] 在 [[高頻高速 PCB 測試解決方案]] 中的量測與提取流程；它沒有提供 CCL 型號、Df 數值範圍或 M 等級。
- [[HSD PCB image 15]] 補充的是 [[DK]] 與 [[Low DK]] 在[[玻纖布]]分級圖卡中的語彙；它沒有提供 Dk / DK 數值、Df 數值、測試頻率或測試標準。
- [[HSD PCB image 18]] 補充的是市場資訊圖把 [[Low Dk]] / [[Low Df]] 作為 [[E-Glass]] 與 [[T-Glass]] 之間的低損耗材料階梯，並連到 AI/5G 應用；它沒有提供 Dk、Df、損耗、頻率、厚度、樹脂、玻纖布規格或測試標準。
- [[snla426]] 補充的是 [[PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout]] application note 脈絡下，Df / Dissipation Factor、dielectric loss、εr、fiberglass / epoxy 差異與 material insertion loss 的設計說法。
- 因 [[AI Server PCB test image 24]]、[[AI Server PCB test image 19]]、[[HSD PCB image 15]]、[[HSD PCB image 18]] 與 [[snla426]] 未提供共同測試條件，本頁不把其 Dk、DK、Df、M 等級或 SDD21 數字直接互相換算。

Dk-Df › Dk/Df
[[Dk-Df]] 是市場與技術來源中用於描述 [[PCB]] 原材料、基材、層壓板材料、[[玻纖布]]分級或 high-speed transmission line loss 的介電相關語彙；既有來源以 [[Df]] 記錄 [[CCL]] 產品規格分級，[[HSD PCB image 15]] 以 [[DK]] 與 [[Low DK]] 說明玻纖布材質低介電 / 低延遲，[[HSD PCB image 18]] 則把 [[Low Dk]] / [[Low Df]] 作為材料演進階梯中的低損耗層級。[[snla426]] 補入 Texas Instruments 在 [[PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout]] 脈絡中對 Df / Dissipation Factor、dielectric loss、εr 與 material insertion loss 的說法。

- Inline [[R&S ZN-Z33]] calibration unit operates up to 40 GHz。
- TVAC compatible。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]] 在 factory 中針對 –30 °C 至 +80 °C temperature range 進行 characterized，以便在 vacuum conditions 下工作。
- Low insertion loss：typ. 1.5 dB at 1 GHz；5 dB at 40 GHz。
- High effective directivity：typ. 38 dB between 700 MHz and 20 GHz。
- [[R&S ZN-Z30]] controller 支援最多 48 個 calibration units。

- [[R&S AREG-MFP]]、[[R&S AREG-BFP]] — production frontend options，支援 monostatic 或 bistatic。
- [[Automotive radar echo generation]]、[[FMCW radar]]、[[Radar cross-section]]、[[Doppler frequency shift]]、[[Hardware-in-the-loop]]、[[Open Simulation Interface]]、[[SCPI]]、[[Air gap]] — 本來源涉及的技術概念。

DUT › 1C111 中的 DUT workflow
依 [[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- 在 [[R&S CMX500]] 3GPP Pre-conformance testing workspace 中，使用者設定 band 與 frequency settings、啟動 network emulation、開啟 cell 之後，需確認 [[DUT]] 已連接。
- 使用者需注意各自 UE capabilities，因為 test cases 不會處理 UE capabilities。
- 選擇 test case 不會覆寫使用者設定的 signaling parameters；使用者需確認目前 configuration 適合所選 test case。
- 有些 Test IDs 只針對特定 frequency + bandwidth combination；若所選 Test ID 沒有 matching configuration，CMX 會在 UL scheduling 顯示 not applicable，並在 GUI 底部 event log 顯示 warning。
- PUCCH subtests 建議關閉 UE data。
- UE 對 UL resources 的每次 scheduling request 都會導致 call drops，因沒有 PUSCH resources 可用。

R&S CMX500 › R&S CMX-B200A accelerator unit
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX-B200A]] 提供 accelerated digital signal processing capabilities，並包含 two high-speed digital I/Q interfaces：

| 項目 | 規格 |
|---|---|
| Ports | DIG. IQ HS 1、DIG. IQ HS 2 |
| Direction | full duplex |
| Connector | QSFP+ |
| Level | CML |
| Data rate | 40 Gbps |

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，每個 accelerator unit 可 fading 的最大 cells 數包含：1 NR cell 8x8 MIMO；1 NR cell 16x4 MIMO, 50 MHz bandwidth；2 NR cells 4x4 MIMO；4 NR cells 2x2 MIMO；2 LTE cells 8x4 MIMO；4 LTE cells 2x2 或 4x4 MIMO。

NTN signaling customer discovery › 2. Test layer
來源要求客戶指出要測試哪一層：

- RF
- Protocol
- Application Testing

這表示 discovery 階段需先分清楚測試目標，而不是只用「NTN testing」作為單一需求描述。

DCP-Config-r16 › 來源列出的相關欄位
[[Wake Up Signal]] 在描述 [[DCI format 2_6]] 時列出多個與 DCP / WUS 相關的 r16 欄位或參數：

- `ps-RNTI-r16`：對應 [[PS-RNTI]]。
- `ps-Offset-r16`：來源文字為 `ps-Offset-r16*0.125ms`，與 WUS search space relative to on-duration DRX cycle 的 timing 有關。
- `duration`：來源說 search space spans `duration` slots。
- `sizeDCI-2-6-r16`：DCI2_6 total length。
- `outsideActiveTimeConfig-r16`：for each UE defines the starting position of its bits inside the whole DCI。
- `ps-WakeUp-r16`：UE does not detect DCI 時的 default behavior，wake up 或 stay asleep。
- `ps-TransmitPeriodicL1CSI-r16`：on-duration cycle does not start 時仍可 transmit periodic L1-RSRP reports 的設定線索。
- `ps-TransmitOtherPeriodicCSI-r16`：on-duration cycle does not start 時仍可 transmit other periodic CSI reports 的設定線索。

Temporary UE capability restriction
[[Temporary UE capability restriction]] 是 Release 18 [[Dual SIM Dual Active]] / [[Multi-USIM operation]] 中，UE 因雙 SIM active connection 共用硬體能力而向 network 回報暫時能力限制的機制。

- [[02160280]] 內容聚焦 [[FORMOSAT-5]] 的[[衛星電力次系統]]、[[PCDU]]、電池、太陽能板、控制軟體演算法與電能平衡分析。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 與既有知識的關係
本來源已對應既有來源頁 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] 與實體頁 [[R&S AREG800A]]。本次 ingest 依同一 raw source 重新校對既有頁面，補入或修正：

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation

The passages support a chain of **Automotive ADAS/V2X high-speed signal transmission → PCB/SI measurable parameters → VNA capability fields**, but they do **not** directly specify a formal automotive R&S ZNA configuration, option code, fixture, calibration method, or test frequency [22][41][42][47].
| Chain step | Mapped item | Supported statement | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Automotive market requirement | ADAS and V2X communications in cars | Automotive ADAS and V2X communications require high-speed signal transmission [22]. | [22] |
| Technical measurement need | High-speed PCB / signal-integrity parameters | R&S PCB test solutions list impedance by TDR and DK/DF extraction for Material Measurement [41]. | [41] |
| Technical measurement need | Stackup / SI parameters | R&S PCB test solutions list IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram for Material/Stackup selection [41]. | [41] |
| Technical measurement need | SI modeling/testing parameters | R&S PCB test solutions list IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance for Signal Integrity modeling/testing [41]. | [41] |
| Technical measurement need | Sampling-test parameters | R&S PCB test solutions list IL, DK/DF, and impedance for Sampling testing [41]. | [41] |
| VNA capability field | Frequency range and port count | R&S ZNA models cover 10 MHz to 26.5 GHz, 43.5 GHz, 50 GHz, or 67 GHz, and each model provides 2-port or 4-port base units with 50 Ω test-port impedance [47]. | [47] |
| VNA capability field | Dynamic range / sensitivity | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB specification without options, 147 dB typical with options, maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction, and sensitivity >–120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth without options [47]. | [47] |
| VNA capability field | Measurement bandwidth | R&S ZNA measurement bandwidth is 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz for the base unit and 1 Hz to 30 MHz with R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth option [47]. | [47] |
| VNA capability field | Measurement speed | R&S ZNA measurement speed example is 96 ms nominal sweep time for 10 MHz to 43.5 GHz, 500 kHz measurement bandwidth, 1601 points, and 2-port calibration [47]. | [47] |
| Evidence gap | Formal automotive VNA requirement | Slide 21 does not provide formal R&S product model, option code, license, test frequency, test standard, fixture, or calibration method [42]. | [42] |
【推論】For an Automotive ADAS/V2X high-speed signal-transmission requirement, the measurable PCB/SI parameters to map first are IL, impedance/TDR, DK/DF, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram because Automotive ADAS/V2X is stated to need high-speed signal transmission and R&S PCB test solutions list those PCB/SI parameters for high-speed PCB workflows [22][41].
【推論】The corresponding VNA capability checklist is frequency range, port count, 50 Ω ports, dynamic range/sensitivity, measurement bandwidth, and sweep speed, because the measurable PCB/SI items are listed in the PCB test flow and the R&S ZNA passages provide those capability fields and specifications [41][47].
【推論】A specific Automotive R&S ZNA model or option cannot be finalized from these passages alone because the PCB test-solution source does not state product model, option code, test frequency, standard, fixture, or calibration method [42].

High speed SerDes eco-chain › 下游 — 終端應用與市場部署
- 通訊設備製造商：核心網、5G 基站、光傳輸設備、交換機、路由器等。
- 服務器與資料中心：協助 AI、高效能計算環境部署，需求高速內部連與介面連接。
- 網通基礎建設與雲端應用：包含物聯網、雲計算與邊緣運算等場域皆需高速數據傳輸與處理能力。
- 消費電子與車用領域：筆電 / 手機等需 [[HDMI]]、[[DisplayPort]]、[[USB]] 介面，汽車上的 [[ADAS]] 與 [[V2X]] 通訊亦需高速訊號傳輸。
- 工業與智慧製造：工業自動化系統、高速資料擷取與辨識也仰賴高速訊號鏈路。

R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。

R&S PCB test solutions › 可追溯限制
- 本來源沒有提供正式 R&S 產品型號、option code、license、測試頻率、測試標準、fixture 或 calibration method。
- 本頁不把 Slide 21 的圖上列名解讀為正式解決方案型錄或完整採購配置。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 重點摘要
- 型號頻率範圍：
  - [[R&S ZNA26]]：10 MHz to 26.5 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA43]]：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz，可為 2.92 mm 或 2.4 mm ruggedized male test port connector。
  - [[R&S ZNA50]]：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA67]]：10 MHz to 67 GHz。
- 各型號提供 2 ports 或 4 ports base unit；test port impedance 為 50 Ω，DC block 為 standard。
- Key performance 包含：dynamic range > 129 dB specification without options、147 dB typical with options、maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction；sensitivity > –120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specification without options，並有 –162 dBm measured with options（1 kHz measurement bandwidth normalized to 1 Hz）。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；搭配 [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。
- Measurement speed 條件包含 firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)；例：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。
- 4-port instruments：最多 4 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 5 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，4-port model 總計 8 true receivers，無 multiplexing。
- 2-port instruments：最多 2 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 3 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，2-port model 總計 4 true receivers，無 multiplexing。
- Optional rear panel LO out 可支援 mmWave converters；4-port model 最多 4 個 converters，2-port model 最多 2 個 converters，無需 external signal generator；rear panel LO out typ. +25 dBm，最高 26.5 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA-K28]] continuous data recording 支援 infinite data point capture、circular buffer，並可透過 LAN 或 USB 連續資料傳輸。
- [[R&S ZNA-B26]] direct IF access：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。
